sources.title: House of Commons current members XML
Official MLA directory — external link only

limitations: MP officeholders retain their individual verification dates; current parties and offices may change. Municipal names are from the City open ward source verified 14 September 2026. Provincial entries identify districts and link to the official MLA directory without reproducing current officeholders.

Current MLA names, party affiliations and vacancy status are not supplied in this public demo. Historical provincial election results remain separately attributed to Elections Alberta and do not establish who currently holds office.
Municipal party affiliation is not supplied by the open ward dataset; null does not mean Independent.
Address assignments use property points and electoral/ward polygons. These community fallbacks are approximate area-based calculations, not official community-to-ward lists or population shares.

A community gets a fallback ward only if one ward covers at least 99.9% of its area and no other ward covers 0.1% or more. Split, incomplete or conflicting coverage keeps ward and councillor null; use the exact address point.
Area calculations use EPSG:3400. Candidate shares below 0.1% are omitted as boundary slivers. Percentages are rounded for display only after assignment decisions.
Whole-community federal and provincial assignments remain null because communities and electoral districts have different boundaries.
Election history remains limited to the previously researched two federal and two provincial districts.
municipalDataSource: City Open Data tz8z-hyaz councillors and ward polygons; community fallback coverage independently calculated from surr-xmvs polygons. No City webpage community-list extraction is retained.

municipalMappingMethodology.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – City of Calgary.

acknowledgements.house: Source: House of Commons, Current Members of Parliament designated open XML feed. Current officeholder fields verified 13 September 2026. Election-time affiliations are recorded separately.
acknowledgements.assemblyDirectory: Current MLA information is linked to the official Legislative Assembly of Alberta directory; no current directory fields are reproduced.
acknowledgements.provincialBoundaries: District matching uses Elections Alberta, Maps — Shapefiles: Electoral Divisions (effective March 19, 2019). The boundary source labels and dates are retained separately from current-officeholder information.
